query: If I participate in the Drive and Save (DAS) Scheme, will my Taxi Driver Vocational Licence (TDVL) be automatically renewed?
reference_answer: No, Taxi Driver Vocational Licences (TDVL) will not be automatically renewed upon participation in the Drive and Save (DAS) Scheme.Taxi principal hirers must have fully paid their MediSave payable or are making monthly payments via GIRO to renew their TDVLs.MediSave contributions1and co-contributions from taxi operators will offset mandatory MediSave contributions under the Self-Employed Scheme.1Taxi principal hirers may make MediSave contributions as self-employed persons viaManage your MediSave payableorGIRO.
answer: Based on the information available, participating in the Drive and Save (DAS) Scheme does not automatically renew your Taxi Driver Vocational Licence (TDVL). [Document N]
